description.value: Butcher Boys Food Market is a locally-owned neighbourhood grocery store that has served the Vernon community for over 40 years, sitting at the corner of Pleasant Valley Road and Silver Star Road. The store operates full meat, produce, bakery, and deli departments under family management, preserving what they describe as an old-fashioned, personal-touch shopping experience. It is conveniently located on the route toward Silver Star Mountain and offers grocery delivery to surrounding areas including Coldstream and the BX.

address.value: 4803 Pleasant Valley Road, Vernon, BC V1B 3L7
